# What's new in 1.3.6

Released **2026-10-11**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Plan list.** Yesterday and earlier stay off the calendar. Today is highlighted, with a line that names today’s sessions or the next one.
- **Windows 11 portable zip.** Unzip and run `steadyGrind.exe` (tray agent + WebView2). Same Wi‑Fi KICKR / Emulator flow as macOS.

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-1.3.6-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- `steadyGrind-1.3.6-windows.zip` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v1.3.6
